text: colm's driving test is 2 November 2026, third go. he's bricking it, failed last time on a roundabout and his instructor Mrs Baker has him doing mock tests every sat now. his gf Noor is lending him her car for extra practice which is brave of her. remind me to text him good luck the night b4 and ask how it went that afternoon
imani got a puppy!! cockapoo called biscuit, picking him up end of the month
noor's cat Pickle has a lump on her side, vet appt sometime next week. noor's in bits about it
lukas passed his theory test this morning. practical booked for early march
remind me to ring tamar the evening after her audition for the youth orchestra, it's thurs
shreya - results day for her masters is 14 jan 2027. she reckons she's failed the stats module but she always says that
ethan's dog Rolo turns 5 on saturday, his mum is doing a doggy cake lol
pick up flea stuff for the cat and book her booster b4 the end of nov
siobhan and her husband Delroy are expecting, due over the summer. she's had awful morning sickness

dorota - allergic to cats so never suggest mine come over when she visits

must send leah the revision timetable template b4 her mocks start next mon

tanvi got 3 A*s!! off to cambridge. send congrats tmrw
lachlan's mate from rugby lost his greyhound, lachlan took it hard as he walked it a lot
kasia is learning to drive at 40, first lesson tmrw. she's proper anxious
ann (my neighbour) says her cat Smudge went missing sat night. said i'd keep an eye out
rosa's grade 8 violin exam went well, results in a few wks. she's practising 3 hrs a day now for conservatoire
delroy loves birdwatching, joined the rspb. good gift idea - a decent pair of binoculars, he hinted twice
leon's puppy chewed through his laptop charger lol. beagle called Ziggy
yusuf's GCSE results next thurs. his dad Hassan says yusuf hasn't slept properly in a wk. remind me to text yusuf the day before
dong has his citizenship test on 9 dec 2026. very nervous about the history bit, offered to quiz him

vet called - Mango's bloods all fine, kidneys normal. phew
colm aka the colmster lol - his band is doing a battle of the bands thing end of the month, wants us there
imani's brother Leon passed his bar exam!! she said their mum cried for an hour
need to get niamh a card for her grade results, she got a distinction. and maybe one of those music shop vouchers
noor's sister Tanvi has a scan on monday, 20 wks. noor's going with her

quick call w/ lukas re the puppy - they're getting a husky from a breeder in wales, collecting it the week before christmas. his partner Manon wanted a smaller dog but lost the argument. their kids have already named it Thor. lukas worried about it and the cat, Pepper is 14 and not a fan of anything. remind me to send him that crate training video the weekend after they bring it home
tamar didn't get the part. second audition this year she's missed out on. she's pretty low, should take her out for coffee sometime next week

lunch w/ shreya. she's moving to bristol for her phd in jan 2027, already found a flat in clifton. vegan now btw, so no more steak nights. her viva for the masters is early december and she's weirdly calm. her mum's not thrilled about the move, wanted her closer to home in leicester. i should help her pack over xmas, said i'd bring the van

ethan's mum had a fall last wk, broken wrist, and she's 82 so it's a big deal. he's driving up to york every weekend to help out and his brother Arturo is useless apparently. ethan's also got his own exam for work, the accountancy one, on 2 december 2026, and he's barely revised. ask how she's doing when i see him at five a side thurs

siobhan's husband delroy has his cfa level 2 exam in may 2027. she says he's studying every night after work and they barely see each other. their dog Max is the only one getting walks lol. he failed level 2 once already so the pressure's on, his boss is apparently making it a condition of the promotion. she's a bit fed up tbh. should invite her round one eve sometime next week so she gets a break
demi's hamster died this morning. she's 7 so absolutely devastated. her mum asked if i could get her a little something
self assessment due 31 jan. dentist end of nov. sort both

dorota's son Kuba has his first swimming gala sat. she can't make it as she's working a double, ex is taking him. she's gutted. he's been training at 6am tues and thurs for months and has his heart set on the 50m backstroke. also his grade 2 swim badge test is end of the month. text her that eve to ask how he did and maybe send kuba a little well done card

amy said her parents' collie Bramble is 15 now and they're having a little party for it on sunday with a doggy cake and everything. very amy family. her dad's been a bit unwell, hip replacement booked for early march, so amy's going up every other weekend. she's also got her own theory test on the 30th and hasn't revised at all
sana's driving test is booked for 2 nov 2026 at 9am. lessons twice a wk until then. she's surprisingly chill about it
kavya just got a kitten, ginger, called Paprika. she sent about 40 photos. her partner Owen is allergic but apparently it's fine??
leah's sat her final nursing exam today. results early march. she thinks it went ok

owen's mum Julia retiring end of the month after 35 yrs teaching year 6. owen's organising a surprise do at the cricket club on the 29th, i'm doing the playlist. she loves abba and northern soul. she's dropped hints about wanting a proper garden bench for her retirement so we might all chip in. need to give owen £20 by friday
arturo's band audition got called off, venue double booked. now he's just doing an open mic on fri instead
hamza's twins start nursery in january. he says his wife is dreading it more than them
tanvi - driving test passed first time!! told her i'd take her for a drink to celebrate
lachlan's sister Kasia is training for the london marathon april 2027, running for the cat protection league as her cat Tigger was a rescue. don't forget to sponsor her b4 payday runs out
ann petrov from the book club - her granddaughter does grade 3 ballet exam next wk. ann's making her costume
rosa costa nervous re her piano recital on the 22nd. remind me to text her good luck the morning of and then ring her after
delroy's spaniel had puppies, 6 of them! he's keeping one, selling rest early dec. said i'd ask around
vet appt for the dog thurs 4pm then pick up the new lead

leon says his dad has his heart check up results sometime next week, after the scare in the summer. leon trying to keep busy, he's worried and has taken a few days off work. his sister Kavya flies back from dubai to be there. remind me to call him the evening after and drop off a lasagne or something that wk
dong chen - new to the team, really into reptiles, has a bearded dragon called Kevin. also does kickboxing
manon's audition for the choir is tues. she's been practising in the car lol. message her that evening to see how it went

hassan's cat is diabetic now, insulin twice a day, he's had to learn to do the injections. he's cancelled his holiday to portugal in march 2027 because he can't find a sitter who'll do it. honestly could offer to do it myself, i'm around. his wife Imani says he's been really stressed and not sleeping. their son Yusuf also has his driving test sometime next month so lots going on in that house
hm. nothing much from the catch up w/ julia, mostly about work stuff. she's still at the council
